basic_profile.bio: I'm Alex, a 36-year-old technology enthusiast from Portland, Oregon. I've recently ventured into building my first PC and exploring the exciting world of DIY tech. By day, I work as an HR manager in a mid-sized tech company, and by night, I dive into tech forums and gaming communities. I enjoy learning about new gadgets and sound systems, especially soundbars. I'm currently single and spend my evenings online, usually between 7 PM and midnight PST.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a moderate understanding of technology, mostly self-taught through online resources and forums. My interest in building PCs started when I wanted to enhance my gaming experience. I've also dabbled in sound systems, learning from reviews and community recommendations.
